scope: Reviewer-authored standard-library GLB binary decoder. Decodes POSITION/index bytes, applies node matrices/TRS, measures default-scene mesh instances/bounds, reads clip input accessors, validates frozen anchor/hierarchy/clip expectations, and compares pre-static-batching to final world-space triangles by material at 1e-4 m contract tolerance. Skin deformation is separately measured by fresh browser samples; static triangle comparison is not a likeness/visual acceptance.
